## Text Version / Adapted Text {#states-of-mind}

Mindfulness is intentional attention to present experience. The source distinguishes **reasonable mind**, which emphasizes facts and logic; **emotion mind**, in which emotion strongly shapes attention and action; and **Wise Mind**, which brings emotion and reason together with direct awareness of what matters.

### Practising Wise Mind {#practising-wise-mind}

Pause and observe the current facts, emotions, sensations, thoughts, and urges. Ask what you know from both reason and lived experience. A Wise Mind response may be quiet or uncertain; it does not require the absence of emotion.

### Practice {#practice}

Choose an ordinary activity. Notice when attention moves away, name that gently, and return. Repetition is the practice; losing focus is not failure.
